title: The Perfect Gift 2 | Christmas Advert 2026 | Waitrose

segments.description: Wide aerial shot of a snowy English estate under a bright winter sky [[00:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8V3eMYkV1Hw&t=2)].
